research_question: On which unseen recordings and causal prefixes is waiting or buying video worth its cost, and does a physical free boundary improve that decision?
task: Identify the performed instrument, piano or guitar, on original real audiovisual productions drawn from Wikimedia Commons. Unit of transfer is the independently sourced recording/creator. Treat multiple segments from the same source as dependent. Fixed class identities; disjoint gallery recordings. New task/corpus compared with the previous two-utterance RAVDESS retrieval. No artificial audio degradation or manufactured visual side channel.
splits: Separate dedicated gallery, TRAIN, DEV, RETAIN, TEST. Freeze title/creator/master/split and deterministic nonoverlapping segment roster using provenance and stream-integrity checks before outcome inspection. Common or ambiguous shared masters/creator provenance must be clustered or excluded. Freeze the entire TEST list before frontend discovery. If unavoidable substitutions, record a pre-score erratum. TEST has no fitting or selection use.
free_frontend: One common clean audio classifier for all candidates, trained with equal class/source influence with within-TRAIN source-held-out predictions for TRAIN, frozen TRAIN+gallery model for other splits. Report same-audio gallery-only and class-balanced linear or nearest-recording controls for diagnostic context. The causal controller receives current and previous free audio confidence/descriptor summaries and clock.
paid_frontends: Class prediction from dedicated gallery handcrafted visual nearest scores, source-cross-fit handcrafted visual linear classifier, frozen torchvision ImageNet ResNet18 class logits over grand/upright piano vs acoustic/electric guitar, and a 75% semantic vision + 25% free-audio probability mixture. Cold unavailable candidates remain unavailable with cause; no substitute after scoring. Model/frames/normalization versions, archive digest and sample times recorded. Purchased read terminates on that action's score. Deployment supplies query video only after purchase.
capability: Per recording/creator-macro difference of clairvoyant joint best utility over all legal stops/reads/times vs clairvoyant free-only best utility. To open TEST for a frontend require gain >=.03 and at least two independent groups with strict improvement in EACH of TRAIN and DEV. Waiting vs joint immediate oracle is reported separately, with descriptive .015 / two-group reference. Capability does not establish predictability.
selection: No TEST metrics before final frontend/price AND policy seal. Among capable frontends first prefer one with a positive DEV causal utility gain versus restricted dynamic noREAD AND the immediate-acting causal policy, then maximize the smaller of those two DEV deltas, then maximize full DEV utility, then fixed frontend order. If none qualify, hold TEST closed for this design and report negative. Preserve every considered result.
controls: Always immediate free and immediate paid, fixed exits, strictly TRAIN-fitted causal intervention with full action set, trained dynamic noREAD, same chosen policy with READ disabled, immediate-only causal intervention, perfect-information upper bounds. Compare source-macro policy utility, R@1, read/stop/wait timing, verified conditional errors and worst source. Include source directional/sign uncertainty; clips and seeds from same source are dependent.
hcsn: Three seeds 181391,284729,395201. Same inputs and budgets for fixed, ordinary learned, internal affine regenerative QVI, external finite-task intervention field applied to physical threshold, plain feature baseline, causal intervention comparator. Retain direct centered ridge-SVD and four profiled projected BP steps with original .075 learning rate, .35 trust radius, .001 ridge. Fit conditional value targets with honest source-held-out continuation and realized policy evaluation, no paid observation before READ. Select nonlinear candidates on DEV with <=.05 loss on worst RETAIN group vs matched KEEP. No weight-space edit run this round.
gates: Mean source utility >=.60, R@1 >=.70, worst held-out source utility difference vs own post-SVD KEEP >=-.05 and three seeds for a family. Attribute learned timing only with paired improvements over free/instant or restricted policies as explicitly reported. Report unconditional and incremental metrics separately, preserve baseline victories and negative seeds.
cost: Preserve capture/feature receipts, supervised audio/visual crossfitting, pricing, selection, failed downloads/edit candidates, cold training/confirm and independent replay. Record actual scope and unmeasured charges. Timings across monitoring/computation can overlap. No retune or pretraining claim from final scores.
